dedupe_keys.name: alberta tourism market monitor monthly update 2022

description: Alberta’s tourism market monitor reports monthly air-passenger totals, traffic counts on major highways and accommodation occupancy. It also reports park attendance, employment, food-service receipts and visits to cultural sites. The direct infrastructure subjects are observed aviation and road demand and building occupancy; broader tourism variables remain part of the published series. Twelve annual catalogue members cover 2011 through 2022, with PDF issue descriptors and explicit cross-links to the same series in other years. Returned monthly inventories have gaps, including only one listed 2011 issue, ten 2012 issues and eleven 2022 issues. A specific transport simulation application and detailed counting locations are not stated. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue provides descriptive metadata and exact original Alberta distribution identifiers. It labels the collection Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is through the linked descriptive record; current provider access and actual file downloads are untested. Costs are not stated. No document, workbook, archive or dataset body was fetched, and numerical contents have not been independently checked. Related editions and components are grouped only where the source identifies their relationship. A companion CUDC member identifies XLSX issues from May 2015 through November 2022 and annual PDF summaries for 2015 and 2016. This adds tabular representations to the same named tourism monitor, with duplicate issue descriptors retained in source evidence. The series has gaps and monthly workbook/PDF equivalence was not tested.
